name: Planed and left bare (timber hidden in a fitting)

roughness.source: Workings/planed.json (a planed softwood face, its fibres cut clean and unsealed; no filtered roughness was read)
roughness.note: Rougher than any finished face: nothing fills the cut tracheids.

roughnessAcross.source: Workings/planed.json (no measured roughness across the grain)
roughnessAcross.derivation: a first value: equal to the roughness along until a measurement parts them

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.source: Workings/planed.json (the open tracheids of a softwood, tens of microns across)

relief.source: Workings/planed.json (the earlywood worn below the latewood)

refractiveIndex.derivation: no film: the face meets the air

cover.derivation: bare timber: no film covers the face
